CALL_KINDS = ('decide', 'approve mockup', 'approve UI', 'approve merge', 'action')
ACTION_RE = re.compile('(?i)\\b(token\\w*|chiav[ei]|keys?|vapid|1password|deploy\\w*|sudo\\w*)\\b')
MOCKUP_RE = re.compile('(?i)mockup')
PAGE_SUFFIXES = set('.html .htm .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .avif .svg'.split())

def is_himalaia(it: dict) -> bool:
    return any((C.short_repo(r) == 'himalaia' for r in [it.get('repo', ''), *it.get('repos', [])]))

def local_page(name: object) -> Path | None:
    """Resolve only existing page assets, including our absolute URLs; never fetch URLs."""
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or re.search('\\s|[\\\\\\x00-\\x1f\\x7f]', name):
        return None
    try:
        url = urlsplit(name)
        if url.scheme or url.netloc:
            if f'{url.scheme.lower()}://{url.netloc.lower()}' != PAGES_ORIGIN:
                return None
        elif url.query or (url.fragment and (not re.fullmatch('[\\w\\-.:]+', url.fragment))):
            return None
        rel = unquote(url.path).lstrip('/')
        if not re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+', rel) or '..' in rel:
            return None
        root = (C.O / 'pages').resolve()
        path = (root / rel).resolve()
        if path.is_dir():
            path = (path / 'index.html').resolve()
        if path.is_relative_to(root) and path.suffix.lower() in PAGE_SUFFIXES and path.is_file():
            return path
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        pass
    return None

def first_page(names: list) -> str:
    for name in names:
        if (path := local_page(name)):
            if urlsplit(name).scheme:
                return name
            fragment = urlsplit(name).fragment
            return path.relative_to((C.O / 'pages').resolve()).as_posix() + (f'#{fragment}' if fragment else '')
    return ''

def page_text(name: str, cache: dict) -> str:
    if '://' in name:
        return ''
    if name not in cache:
        path = C.O / 'pages' / name
        try:
            cache[name] = path.read_text(errors='replace') if path.is_file() else ''
        except OSError:
            cache[name] = ''
    return cache[name]

def links_of(it: dict) -> dict:
    g, pages = (it['gates'], it['pages'])
    if is_himalaia(it):
        comparison = g['comparison']
        post = first_page(pages['post'])
        pre = first_page([name for name in pages['pre'] if local_page(name) != local_page(post)])
        comparison_page = local_page(comparison)
        mockup = g['mockup'] if local_page(g['mockup']) != comparison_page else ''
        display = first_page([name for name in pages['display'] if local_page(name) != comparison_page])
        return {'pre': pre, 'mockup': mockup, 'post': post, 'comparison': comparison, 'preview': g['preview'], 'display': display, 'pr': (it['pr'] or {}).get('url', ''), 'issue': (it['issue'] or {}).get('url', '')}
    return {'mockup': g['mockup'], 'comparison': g['comparison'] or (pages['post'] or [''])[0], 'preview': g['preview'], 'display': (pages['display'] or [''])[0], 'pr': (it['pr'] or {}).get('url', ''), 'issue': (it['issue'] or {}).get('url', '')}

def ui_of(it: dict, note: dict) -> bool:
    p = it['pages']
    return bool(p['pre'] or p['post'] or p['mockup']) or note.get('ui') is True

def ask_kind(a: dict, it: dict, decision: dict | None) -> str:
    if a.get('kind') in CALL_KINDS:
        return a['kind']
    if decision and decision.get('call') in CALL_KINDS:
        return decision['call']
    pr = it['pr'] or {}
    if pr.get('state') == 'open' and 'needs-human' in it['labels']:
        return 'approve merge'
    text = f"{a.get('question', '')} {a.get('rec', '')}"
    q = a.get('question', '')
    choice_or_mine = re.search('\\so\\s', q) or re.match('\\W*\\w+o\\b', q)
    if ACTION_RE.search(text) and (not choice_or_mine):
        return 'action'
    if MOCKUP_RE.search(text):
        return 'approve mockup'
    g = it['gates']
    if it['ui'] and it['status'] == 'Merge' and g['comparison'] and g['preview']:
        return 'approve UI'
    return 'decide'
RERUN_RE = re.compile('(?<=[a-z])\\d+$')

def norm_q(text: object) -> str:
    """Question text compared without case, punctuation, backticks or spacing."""
    return re.sub('[\\W_]+', ' ', str(text or '').lower()).strip()

def _heads(decision: str) -> list[str]:
    """dashboard-tasks2-q1 -> [dashboard-tasks2-q1, dashboard-tasks2, dashboard] (long enough only)."""
    parts = decision.split('-')
    return [h for h in ('-'.join(parts[:n]) for n in range(len(parts), 0, -1)) if len(h) > 6]

def owned(it: dict, recs: list[AnswerRec]) -> list[AnswerRec]:
    """Answers that belong to the item: its id, slugs or ask ids, or a re-run of one (tasks2 -> tasks3)."""
    keys = {k.lower() for k in [it['id'], *it.get('aliases', []), *it.get('slugs', []), *(a['id'] for a in it['ask'])] if k}
    stems = {RERUN_RE.sub('', k) for k in keys}
    return [r for r in recs if any((h in keys or RERUN_RE.sub('', h) in stems for h in _heads(r.decision))) or r.decision in keys]

def ask_answered(a: dict, it: dict, mine: list[AnswerRec]) -> bool:
    """An answer under the ask id (any case), or under the item id for an ask without id when it
    answered this question (or recorded no text), or any of the item's answers to the same question."""
    q = norm_q(a['question'])
    sub = {norm_q(x.get(k)) for x in a.get('questions') or [] if isinstance(x, dict) for k in ('id', 'text')}
    for r in mine:
        if a['id'] and r.decision == a['id'].lower():
            return True
        if not a['id'] and r.decision in {k.lower() for k in [it['id'], *it.get('aliases', []), a.get('_item', it['id'])]} and (not r.questions or q in r.questions or r.questions & sub):
            return True
        if q and q in r.questions:
            return True
    return False

def steps_of(note: dict, card: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Human-task steps: notes `steps` > card `steps`; checked from notes `steps_checked`."""
    raw = note.get('steps') if isinstance(note.get('steps'), list) else card.get('steps')
    checked = note.get('steps_checked') if isinstance(note.get('steps_checked'), dict) else {}
    return [s | {'checked': checked.get(s['id']) is True} for s in clean_steps(raw)]

def enrich_asks(it: dict, decisions: dict[str, dict], answers: list[AnswerRec]) -> None:
    """Final kind, decisions.json questions and answered flag on every ask."""
    mine = owned(it, answers)
    for a in it['ask']:
        d = decisions.get(a['id']) if a['id'] else None
        a['kind'] = ask_kind(a, it, d)
        qs = (d or {}).get('questions')
        a['questions'] = qs if isinstance(qs, list) else []
        a['answered'] = bool(a.get('_answered') or ask_answered(a, it, mine))
